# Royal Kandy Tours

> Private driver-guide tours of Sri Lanka, based in Kandy. Every itinerary is planned by hand with chauffeur-guide Nalinda — ancient cities, temples, hill country, wildlife safaris and the south coast — travelling in a private air-conditioned vehicle.

Royal Kandy Tours is a small, Kandy-based private tour service. Guests travel with their own English-speaking chauffeur-guide, and every tour is fully private and can be customised.

- Based in: Kandy, Sri Lanka (tours run island-wide)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +94 77 026 6988
- Email: info@royalkandytours.com
- Booking: send a request through the booking page, which opens WhatsApp. A booking is confirmed only once the itinerary and price are agreed in writing.
- Prices are "starting from" prices in USD for a private tour for 3 people.
- Included in every package: private AC vehicle with unlimited mileage, English-speaking chauffeur-guide, driver and guide accommodation, fuel, highway tolls and parking, airport pickup and drop-off.
- Not included: hotel accommodation, meals, entrance and train tickets, safari jeeps and national park fees, optional activities such as whale watching, international flights and visas, personal expenses, tips.

## Tour packages

- [The Royal Ceylon Heritage Tour — 10 days, from $860 for 3 people](https://www.royalkandytours.com/tour-detail.html): Sigiriya, Dambulla, Kandy, the hill-country train to Ella, a Yala safari, Mirissa and Galle Fort.
- [7-Day Highlights Tour — from $700 for 3 people](https://www.royalkandytours.com/tour-7-day-highlights.html): Sigiriya, Dambulla, Kandy, the Kandy–Ella train, Nine Arch Bridge, Little Adam's Peak and Nuwara Eliya tea country.
- [5-Days Round Tour — from $500 for 3 people](https://www.royalkandytours.com/tour-5-day-round.html): Sigiriya, Polonnaruwa, a Minneriya elephant safari, Dambulla, Kandy and Pinnawala.
- [All tour packages](https://www.royalkandytours.com/tours.html)

## Destinations

- [Kandy](https://www.royalkandytours.com/destination-kandy.html): The sacred Temple of the Tooth, Kandy Lake and the botanical gardens.
- [Ella](https://www.royalkandytours.com/destination-detail.html): The hill-country train, Nine Arch Bridge and Little Adam's Peak.
- [Galle](https://www.royalkandytours.com/destination-galle.html): The UNESCO-listed Galle Fort, colonial streets and the southern coastline.
- [Dambulla](https://www.royalkandytours.com/destination-dambulla.html): The Dambulla Cave Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site carved into a granite rock.
- [Mirissa](https://www.royalkandytours.com/destination-mirissa.html): Golden beaches, whale watching and fresh seafood on the south coast.
- [Anuradhapura](https://www.royalkandytours.com/destination-anuradhapura.html): The ancient sacred city, one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.
- [All destinations](https://www.royalkandytours.com/destinations.html)
